author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoens

Called my Doctor
Said I'm feeling blue
Son, I've gotta
prescription for you

Just put on some reggae
Lovey dubby reggae
A magical elixir
Problem fixer

So I hopped in the truck
Windows down
Dropped the bass
And hit the town
Feeling and Feeding
Righteous beats
on deserted streets

Just put some reggae
Lovey dubby reggae
